decisions.decision: Introduce a distinct protected-path installer primitive rather than widen hwm-publish-request/bootstrap-v1 or the ordinary publisher authority.
decisions.rationale: The required .github installation authority is privileged and recurrent, while the existing ordinary publisher is intentionally fail-closed on protected/self-modifying paths.

decisions.decision: Keep P0A architecture-only in hwm-control and defer installer implementation/live acceptance to blocked P0B #87.
decisions.rationale: Separating contract authorization from privileged installation preserves the architecture barrier and prevents #85 from claiming before transport exists.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Widen the ordinary hwm-lab publisher to accept .github paths.
rejected_alternatives.reason: That collapses distinct trust boundaries and violates the existing bootstrap-v1 protected-path contract.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Reuse the completed #79 one-time publisher bootstrap exception.
rejected_alternatives.reason: INFRA_SPEC limits that exception to the one-time ordinary publisher self-installation and explicitly denies recurring generic mutation.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Use generic connector create_file/update_file/create_commit, direct push, or force reset.
rejected_alternatives.reason: P0A source transport and future protected installation are explicitly controlled and fail-closed; generic writers are not authorized continuation paths.

followups: Publish the protected-path install request/result schemas, ADR 0009, INFRA_SPEC amendment and focused tests through the existing hwm-control controlled publisher; then complete protected P0A lifecycle.
